en: The image is a sepia-toned photograph of a woman in elaborate period costume, including a large feathered hat and a dress with lace and embroidery. She is standing beside a wooden chair and holding a riding crop or stick. The top left corner of the postcard has the handwritten name 'Emma Meissner.' There is a printed mark at the bottom left reading 'P. H. 1794.' The overall style and fashion suggest an early 20th-century theatrical or celebrity portrait.
